headline: ECDIS Safety Contour: The Setting That Matters
insight: If the chart has no contour at your value, ECDIS uses the next deeper one available. Recalculate it from draught, squat and required UKC for every passage.

sources.title: Resolution MSC.232(82): Revised performance standards for ECDIS

meta.description: How ECDIS chooses the safety contour, what goes into the value, and why keeping the last voyage's setting is a common mistake.
meta.question: Who checks the safety contour on your bridge at handover?
meta.altText: Equipment graphic explaining how the ECDIS safety contour is selected and set.
